source.note: Official main build. c764d970 is the merge of PR #119 (an App can watch each model request an Agent run sends, CreateRuntimeInput.onModelRequest) on top of 14e13911 (PR #117, complete memory scope reads and the model memory origin label; PR #116, test only) and 5cbf2601; the packed tree is the repository's public main branch at that merge, with no vendor patch and no dirty files.

steps: Use the public main commit c764d970b9ab934e9621bc5d38ae2471a440749a (the merge of PR #119 on 14e13911).
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline --ignore-scripts (existing store), in two separate detached checkouts.
node scripts/public-api.mjs and node scripts/quality-ratchet.mjs pass against that tree.
pnpm build; pnpm -C packages/sdk pack --pack-destination <isolated-directory>, in each checkout; the two archives are byte-for-byte identical.
Molis Work installs this archive through horizontal/agent-host's file: dependency; the lockfile records the same integrity.
build.note: Official dependency, built from main after PR #119 merged (batch 28, observation collection: the user approved the upstream change). It replaces the 5cbf2601 official build, recorded in patch-history.json.
